WHERE pf.tenure = 'latest'
  AND ((CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) < 0 AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) <= 0)
       OR (date_diff('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-14')) < 78
           AND CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) >= 0))
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64)) AS col2
